name: konglomerat-game-studio
description: Rodja workflows for local Unity gameplay, character and city assets, and evidence-based Windows releases.

interface.longDescription: A free local toolkit with three connected skills: Rodja Game Engineer, Rodja Worldcraft and Rodja Release Ops. Builds on the existing Unity game workflow, with read-only evidence tools and explicit acceptance gates. No cloud server, paid service or account access is included.
defaultPrompt: Rodjo, unapredi jednu povezanu gameplay celinu od koda do Windows provere.
Pregledaj geometriju lika ili gradski teren i sacuvaj postojece animacije i kolizije.
Proveri testove i Windows paket; prijavi dokaz, ogranicenja i sledecih pet poteza.
